title: save_digest answer
description: The memory tool save_digest's answer (SB-P5-13, migration 054): the digest an AI client wrote from digest_sources' list, saved with that list's basis as a new memory of the scope (a draft, labelled the engine's own: source system), with a drawn_from link from it to each memory it was drawn from (drawn_from, newest first). None of those memories changes: no revision, text, tag, version or history entry of theirs moves. unchanged: a live digest of the scope was saved from this basis already, and this answer is that digest's; replayed: an idempotency key's earlier answer. A write's fields otherwise: no memory's words, a project by id and slug only; held when its text was held for review (its links are kept, so a repeat run writes no second one). Listed and answered only with memory.tools on (contracts/README.md 2.1). The JSON in its text content, and on success the same as its structured content; a refusal is isError true with the refusal body (not_due: within a day of the last digest of the key in the scope, or fewer than 10 eligible; conflict: the list no longer hashes to the basis; unknown_project; invalid).

status.description: draft when this call wrote it; a digest saved before may have been confirmed since.

tag.description: The topic tag the digest is of, as a memory stores it (lower case); null for a project's.

drawn_from.description: The memories it was drawn from, newest first: each the target of one of its drawn_from links.
